description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
